description.zh: 飞猫云主打高性价比平民路线，提供 7 元入门档套餐并支持 8 折优惠券。对于预算有限、只需要日常轻度使用 Google 查资料、刷 Twitter/Instagram 与油管视频的用户，是性价比极高的实惠之选。
description.en: Flycat Cloud is a high-performance cross-border proxy provider. Featuring Relay Dedicated / Shadowsocks, 500 Mbps Peak Speed, and full support for Netflix, 4K YouTube streaming, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Starting at ¥7/月.
